keyFindings.description: Two definitions of a live tree: Waiting (l.63) counts a held root as live from the line before the hold, LiveRoots/TreeLive (l.108-122) from Waiting's output, which drops it. A labelled todo child of a held root is not recorded in its tree (engine.go:329 TreeLive false), is recorded as its own root with no RecordedAncestor, is skipped by the sweep, and takes a slot and an architect. Reproduced by a throwaway admit test at 6c58a271: LEGION-300 under held LEGION-214 under live LEGION-168 took slot index 1 with one architect start.

The D2 hold ignores D1: RecordedAncestor is computed for any todo recorded root (l.704) and Waiting drops it with no lifecycle/hand-over check, while AdoptionRefusal refuses release CHILD_NOT_ADOPTABLE. A root that ran (tree_lifecycles row) or a carried orphan, todo again under an unreleased child of live T, waits in no line and cannot be released until T lingers; nobody is told. Reproduced at 6c58a271: waiting = nil with a slot free; release refusal CHILD_NOT_ADOPTABLE 'it ran as a tree of its own'.

l.200 says a held root queues again once a person moves 'its parent, or an ancestor' out from under the tree. A recorded ancestor's event is prepared with reread=false (repositories.go:662) and its record keeps tree T (a re-parent never moves a recorded tree), so Waiting keeps holding the root while T's release_children answers 403 ISSUE_OUTSIDE_TREE (its Dispatch walk no longer reaches T). Fix the behaviour (re-read on a recorded issue's parent change) or narrow the sentence.

settleObserved (l.789) carries Reread onto the Delivered event but not RecordedAncestor; withAncestry set it on the Observed view only (repositories.go:685). An issue recorded between preparation and apply has its delivered event write RecordedAncestor '' (recordObservation), dropping the hold, so the root takes a slot.

Avoidable reads: boot reconcile (l.437) runs prepareIssue per todo summary, each withAncestry opening its own transaction, reading the whole issues table and starting a fresh Dispatch cache, inside the readiness attempt; `own` (repositories.go:704) is computed for unlabelled todo issues that never queue; every unrecorded issue's event (any status) re-walks every parented queued root's chain sequentially, so one failing ancestor read naks unrelated events. Build one ancestry for the listing, skip own for !HandedOver, bound the reread.

AdoptionRefusal reads the target root and TreeLive (all issues and slots) per child (l.57-68) though adoptChildren shares one tree and adoptQueuedRoots already holds LiveRoots; batched into the Fast-follow line.
